method: Subset and join existing full gene matrices; no RNA or proteomic re-quantification. Gene reference distributions calculated directly from existing full matrices. Protein rankings reused from pre-existing common-set comparisons.
cautions: Caris and Tempus research TPM are not native vendor TPM.
BostonGene and Tempus are different assays of the same B4 archival resection block.
B7 proteins come from a different block of the same archival resection.
Valius merged bulk specimen provenance remains unresolved.
cfRNA and buffycoat are blood, not tumour biopsies.
Liver includes a selected 101-gene panel and biased recovered cell counts, not a full matrix.
GSE50760 primary18 is an exploratory cross-assay reference, not assay-matched clinical percentiles.
No current-node RNA/proteome or tumour-reactive TCR functional specificity available.
Absent protein/selected-cell gene entries do not establish absence.
No gene expression value identifies primed neoantigen-specific cells or proves defective IL15 signalling.
public_reproduction: Selected original values bundled; script repeats the join and reference quantiles. No panel-scoring inference.
